item.tib: gsas mkhar mchog lnga'i sgrub thabs 'dod 'byung gter gyi bang mdzod
item.coloph: phyis dus la babs nas nges med bdag la ye shes mkha' 'gros bka' gter gnyis med dgongs pa brda' brgyud kyi tshul du brda' yig bstan nas byin gyis brlabs te/ blo la nges pa'i thig le du mar shar bzhin/ dad ldan snying (gi) grogs po ye shes don 'grub nas/ khro bo rnam par 'joms pa'i tsakli dang / byang sems gab pa dgu skor gyi glegs bam dang / seng lding gi DA ma ru sogs lha gos dri ma med pa dar dkar yug gcig gi rten 'brel gyis sna drangs nas snga phyi nan cher yang yang bskul ngor/ skabs su bab pa'i rten 'brel la brten nas/ nges med zog po ldong rigs theg mchog mi 'gyur snying po 'bod pa'i bsgres po ba bgrang bya don gcig lon pa'i thog dus kyi 'pho 'gyur chen po byung zhing me rtar bstan gnyis rtsi sbur mer bsreg ltar btang ba'i skabs su/ slar yang me lug zla tshes bzang por thod rgal snang bzhi'i nyams len la 'bad cing mnyam rjes dbyer med snang ba (?)
